notes: The KPI board. Only numbers we can redeem go on the board. Impressions and trending topics stay off. Six measures. Cup codes: cups picked up and scanned at stations, by city and show. Voucher redemption: vouchers redeemed within seven days of the show divided by vouchers issued. Co-brand uplift: weekly co-branded sales in show cities minus similar control cities, the closest we get to true incremental sales. Thirty-day repeat: the share of scanned members who buy again within 30 days. Stub swaps: stub redemptions by city and merchant. Sentiment: the share of negative mentions, where a trigger starts the four-hour response. We set no targets yet, because no published case gives a credible baseline. The first stop sets the baseline, and targets for the second tranche follow. The board goes to management every week.
